answer: Locks are written down in ivory, expire in karst, and vine lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 104 aliases therefore needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4286 identities would post 4800 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
